intended_object: This is the canonical isomorphism of commutative Hopf algebras over A between O(GLₙ,A)/J_A, the Chevalley group scheme cut out inside GLₙ over A, and A ⊗_ℤ (O(GLₙ,ℤ)/J), the base change of the Chevalley group scheme over ℤ. In words: the group scheme obtained by presenting inside GLₙ over A is the base change of the one over ℤ. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
